title: Sega 1591b: Filippo Sega, Bishop of Piacenza, Paris, early January 1591, duplicate (AAV Francia 32, ff. 49v-54v), read in part with Meister key 65

documents.shelfmark: Archivio Apostolico Vaticano, Segreteria di Stato, Francia 32, ff. 49r-54v (enciphered part ff. 49v-54v), DECODE R5615

plaintext.source: No contemporary decipherment of this letter in the DECODE records of Francia 32 (R5612-R5618, R5621).

transcription.notes: 88 blocks, each frozen before decoding; pale ink and show-through on ff. 51v-54v; several signs not in the printed key (listed in reading.md).

system.summary: Meister key 65: letters as digit pairs, vowels as signs on the pair or on a single digit, nulls, code letters and symbols for common words, three-digit nomenclator

prior_solution.where: No decipherment of this letter in the Francia 32 records on DECODE; no edition of Sega's 1590-1591 dispatches found (checked 29 Oct 2026).

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout chose the target from the catalogue and set the rules (frozen key before validation, held-out checks, prior-work search the day of publication); AI agents transcribed, solved, checked and wrote up. Doubtful signs were settled by targeted visual review where stated.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Meister key 65, as identified for Sega by Lasry (sega1591) and validated for sega1590 on the decifrato of 21 Dec 1590 (0.934 / 0.862 vs at most 0.551 / 0.492).

Whole enciphered part, ff. 49v-54v: 88 blocks, each transcribed and frozen before decoding with key 65 unchanged, read by sense; one final count at the end of the letter: 1,091 of 1,319 words read in their sense (82.7%).

Integration review (pull request #377): key.tsv compared with targets/sega1590/key.tsv (values identical); lines 1-4 of f. 49v re-decoded sign by sign with key 65 and matched decryption.txt; marks in reading.md recounted (205 probable, 3 restored, 224-225 unresolved, consistent with the contributor's final count).

outcome.method_basis: Published historical key (Meister 1906, no. 65) applied unchanged, validated on a held-out letter of the same series with a contemporary decipherment (see targets/sega1590).
outcome.fraction_read_source: reading.md: enciphered words of ff. 49v-54v, 1,319 words: 886 certain + 205 probable read in their sense (1,091), 3 restored and 225 unresolved counted unread.

credits.note: duplicate of early Jan 1591 (Francia 32 ff. 49v-54v, DECODE R5615) transcribed in 88 frozen blocks and read in part with Meister key 65 (82.7%); English translation

texts.label: Sega, Paris, early Jan 1591 (duplicate), enciphered part ff. 49v-54v
texts.summary: Sega on League Paris under Navarre's blockade: passports that angered Navarre, Cardinal de Gondi refusing the oath, Brissac's mission, a request for troops and victuals, Saint-Denis, plots at Orleans, Nantes and Chalon, a divided Union and the plan to put Paris under the protection of the Holy See.

reading_review.note: Read as sentences from reading.md and translation.md (not re-deciphered, not re-checked against the images): ff. 49v-51r read as continuous Italian sentences with scattered holes; from f. 51v the sentences keep their sense but holes are frequent and kept in place; translation bracketed where the cipher is not read.

gaps.detail: pale ink and show-through on the DECODE study images; a better image or the original at the AAV is needed

gaps.item: signs absent from Meister's printed key (long s with a crook x6, delta at the head of a clause, single marks)
end of the letter (copy stops at the foot of f. 54v)
gaps.detail: no original or decifrato of this letter among the DECODE records of Francia 32
